artworks.title: Lepeintre Ainé in the Role of Paillasse
artworks.description: The illustration shows a person standing, with one arm raised above their head and the other pointing outward. They have distinct facial features with a pronounced nose and a subtle smile. The person's hair is short and neat. They are wearing a voluminous, patterned jacket with large buttons, tight-fitting knee-length pants, decorated shoes, and a necklace with a pendant. The background is plain with no specific details or scenery.

artworks.title: On demande une réponse par le courrier
artworks.description: The image shows three people each depicted from about the knees up. In the center, a young woman is seated on the arm of a couch, leaning forward as she reads a letter. She is wearing a dark, off-the-shoulder dress with detailed fabric. Beside her stands an older woman with curly hair peeking out from under a bonnet, dressed in a light-colored outfit with layers and a shawl. In the background, another woman stands by the door holding a tray. The room is furnished with a carpet, a sofa, and a small table with items. Two small dogs are visible on the floor in front of the couch.

artworks.title: Madame demande son café
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man standing close to each other. Both individuals are shown from the thighs up. The woman is turned slightly to her right, extending a cup and saucer towards the man. She has a delicate profile with her hair styled under a bonnet and wears a dress with long sleeves and a ruffled collar. The man faces the woman with a side profile visible and has short, dark hair and sharp facial features. He is dressed in a suit or formal jacket, with a ribbon or ascot around his neck and holds a bundle of large, leafy radishes in his left hand, displaying them prominently at his side. The setting appears to be a room with panels or drapes in the background.

artworks.title: Dis-Donc, grande soeur...
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child in a domestic interior. The woman stands on the left, holding a bowl or cup, wearing a long dress. A child sits on the right on a large container, holding a doll. The background includes a partial view of a door and decorative wall elements.

artworks.title: Il a le cauchemar...
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated on a sofa with large cushions. The man on the left is leaning forward slightly with his head tilted down, eyes closed, and mouth partially open. He has wavy dark hair and a mustache, wearing a light-colored shirt and dark pants. The man on the right is reclining with his head back against the cushions, eyes closed, and smoke coming from his mouth. He has closely cropped dark hair. The setting includes a decorative clock and an abstract piece of furniture or art on the walls.

artworks.title: L'Angleterre, la Russie, l'Autriche...leur parfaite alliance
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various allegorical and symbolic figures interacting with a large figure being tossed into the air. The scene includes a rotund figure with a globe-like head and words like "CHARTE" and "VALMY" on his garments. This figure is being thrown into the air on a blanket labeled with "TRAITÉS DE 1815" and "PROTOCOL" by other figures in military attire. The composition suggests a political or satirical commentary, utilizing symbols and text to convey interactions and alliances during a historical period. The drawing showcases detailed cross-hatching and line work typical of 19th-century political cartoons, adding depth and tone to the scene.

artworks.title: ...alors, il s'approcha d'elle: Parody of van Dyck's Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a crowded and dramatic scene with various figures interacting around a central figure. The composition shows a chaotic atmosphere with animated gestures and interactions. The central figure is standing barefooted and slightly leaning to one side, with exaggerated expressions on other figures suggesting satire or critique. In the background, there are architectural elements and statues. The drawing has a satirical tone reminiscent of 19th-century visual satire.

artworks.title: La Pensée Immunable
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a flower growing from a bag filled with coins. The drawing shows a single pansy plant emerging from a sack labeled "LA PENSÉE IMMUTABLE." The sack is filled with coins, and the flower's face has a human-like expression. The monogram "AB" is seen on the lower left, with a text underneath that relates to the theme.

artworks.title: Social Vignettes
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures engaging in different activities. In the foreground on the left, a man is shown walking briskly in a military uniform with a rifle slung over his shoulder. Adjacent to him, in the mid-ground, a smaller figure of a child or young person is carrying a basket. Another vignette includes a man in a stately stance on the right, wearing a top hat and holding a cane, and a woman in a full-length dress interacting with a large fabric drum. In the background on the right, a person is riding a galloping horse. At the bottom of the image, further in the background, a horse-drawn cart is visible. The background consists of varied landscapes, including buildings, trees, and open fields, all in a sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Le Grand Prix de vertu
artworks.description: Two men are shown in the image. One man is standing behind a large, ornately decorated desk, reaching forward to place a laurel crown on the head of another man who is bowing before him. The man standing has short, slicked-back hair and distinguished facial features. He is dressed in an elegant suit with a high-collared shirt and cravat. The man bowing is wearing a long coat with curly hair. He is holding a hat under his arm and appears to be receiving a medal or token. The background shows a rounded arena filled with elegantly dressed spectators, some with feathers in their hair, watching attentively. The setting is adorned with heavy curtains and ornate furnishings, creating a grand and formal ambiance.

artworks.title: Funeste accidente arrivé à Absalon Leroux
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two riders and their mounts. In the scene, one figure is entangled in tree branches while riding a donkey, and another rider follows closely behind on a horse with a stick in hand. The drawing is monochrome with bold outlines and shading to emphasize movement and texture, showcasing a caricature-like style. The scene conveys a sense of chaos and misadventure amidst a cartoonish backdrop.

artworks.title: Apollon vendant sa lyre
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals engaged in an exchange. The person on the left is standing and holding a lyre, presenting it to the person on the right. This individual appears to have curly hair and a classical visage. They are dressed in a tunic with detailed draping and sandals. The person on the right is facing the first individual, holding a stringed instrument and dressed differently. This individual has unkempt hair and a beard, wearing a tall hat and a long coat with visible patches. They appear to have additional clothing items slung over their arm. The background features classical architecture, including a large domed building and columns. The ground appears textured, with lines indicating a paved street setting.

artworks.title: Jupiter sommant Mr. Charles Dupin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythological figures in a confrontational scene. The image shows a figure on the left extending a hand holding sheaves towards a second figure on the right, who is adorned with a crown of wheat and holding a sickle and a sheaf of wheat. The drawing is executed in a monochromatic style using pencil or ink with intricate line work emphasizing the drapery and features of both figures. At the feet of the left figure, there is a bird. The style is caricature-like, often seen in satirical works. The simplistic yet detailed representation suggests a focus on character and narrative rather than realism.

artworks.title: Liberté
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricature featuring a small child being restrained by several men. The image depicts a group of men in 19th-century attire holding ropes attached to a young girl, who is pulling away from them with an expression of determination. Each man exhibits different body language and facial expressions. The child symbolizes struggle and the era's social or political dynamics. The title suggests themes of liberation.

artworks.title: Les Ecrevisses à Longchamps
artworks.description: This is a drawing of oversized crustaceans and various figures. The artwork depicts a group of people dressed in extravagant 18th-century costumes and hairstyles, standing around and atop giant crayfish that occupy much of the foreground. One character leans on a long stick or cane while another gestures with an umbrella. In the background, a procession of horsemen and a carriage can be seen moving down a tree-lined avenue. A flag with a pair of scissors depicted above some figures suggests a theme of cutting or fashion.

artworks.title: Le Déménagement de la Censure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a group of characters on a cart. The cart is crowded with figures wearing surreal and exaggerated costumes. Features include large hats, exaggerated noses, and masks. Pairs of scissors float above the cart. On the right, a creature resembling a winged demon or dragon is present. The background includes a building with a sign "Maison à louer" (House for rent). The drawing has a satirical quality, likely pointing to societal or political commentary with its caricatured and exaggerated figures.

artworks.title: Duel Polemique
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a duel between a woman and a man on horseback. The horses are small, and the riders are using quills instead of lances. A judge oversees the scene, with onlookers gathered on either side, some appearing to be members of the press.

artworks.title: Scène révolutionnaire: Parody on the Last Supper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting around a long table. The central figure is leaning forward with hands on the table, wearing a sleeveless dress and with long, wavy hair. The surrounding individuals are engaged in various interactions, some pointing or reaching towards each other. Men on either side wear suits or uniforms, with facial features including mustaches and sideburns. Some individuals appear older with receding hairlines or longer, swept-back hair. Several people hold papers, fruit, and objects like a crown and a paper labeled "Liste d'or." The background is a simple, shaded wall, creating focus on the foreground scene with indoor lighting.

artworks.title: Adoration des Mages
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals in an interior setting, with their bodies mostly visible from the waist up. The people are predominantly bent or crouching towards a raised seat or chair, which appears central and prominent in the composition. Most individuals are bald or have receding hairlines, with some wearing wigs typical of the 18th-century style, featuring curls or powdered hair. Many appear elderly with prominent facial lines. They are dressed in ornate clothing that suggests formality or high status, including suits adorned with sashes and medals. Several carry swords at their sides. Around them is a crowded room with numerous people, and the background is filled with a mix of sketchy outlines of additional figures, lending a sense of depth to the scene. No visible jewelry catches the eye, and objects held by them are limited to the swords. The scene, rendered in a soft pencil or lithographic style, exudes a historic and formal ambiance.

artworks.title: La Crinoline-Abri
artworks.description: This drawing features people taking shelter under large crinoline skirts, treating them as tents. The crinolines are exaggeratedly large, dominating the composition. Two figures are comfortably seated underneath. The setting appears outdoors, with grassy ground and distant trees. The style suggests a satirical commentary on societal or fashion trends. The drawing is detailed, with attention given to the fabric folds. The scene conveys a lighthearted and whimsical tone.

artworks.title: Street Scene
artworks.description:
The image shows a group of people with two women in the foreground. The women are walking side by side, their bodies facing forward as they stride ahead. The woman on the left has long, wavy hair styled voluminously and wears a dark, full-length cloak with ruffled edges over a dress with layers of fabric, including a visible underskirt with a light trim. The woman on the right has similar voluminous, wavy hair and is dressed in a lighter-colored gown beneath a cloak, draped over one arm as she walks. They both have shawls or capes and wear fabric headdresses or bonnets. 

In the background are several men dressed in long coats and top hats, with minimal facial detail, and some with moustaches. The scene is sketched in a monochrome palette, with shadows and lines creating texture and form. The background is moderately detailed, focusing on the crowd surrounding the central figures.

artworks.title: "Voyons! Mme Majeste..."
artworks.description: Two women are shown in conversation. The woman on the left is in profile and leans slightly forward towards the woman on the right. She wears a headscarf and holds a basket. The woman on the right faces forward with her head turned towards the other woman. Both are dressed in layered clothing, and the background depicts a busy outdoor setting, possibly a market.

artworks.title: Mascarade
artworks.description: The image depicts a masquerade scene with multiple figures in a large gathering space. The setting includes figures in various costumes and masks, creating a festive atmosphere. The scene is situated in a large space with curved walls and pillars, giving a sense of grandeur and openness. The upper balcony area is filled with seated figures, while the main floor is active with standing figures engaged in conversation. The detailed drawing captures the essence of a masquerade ball with its variety of attire and masked faces.

artworks.title: Quand on pense...
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man and a woman seated on a couch. The man is holding a drawing pad or a book, with his head slightly bowed. The woman is sitting closely beside him, with her upper body leaning towards him and her right arm resting on his shoulder. The man has short, dark hair and a beard, while the woman has curly hair falling around her face. The man is dressed in a jacket, shirt, patterned trousers, and slip-on shoes. The woman wears a dress with voluminous sleeves. They are seated on a cushioned couch with a simple patterned fabric. The background is minimal, with a fabric curtain partially drawn on the left side.
